name: Frame Guard
description: Defends your frame rate in heavy levels: unlimited FPS toggle and a self-verifying batch draw fast path.

unlimited-fps.name: Unlimited FPS
unlimited-fps.description: Removes the FPS cap and turns VSync off. Turning this off restores GD's own frame interval; restart the game to get GD's VSync setting back.

fast-batch.name: Batch fast path
fast-batch.description: Skips clean sprites in CCSpriteBatchNode::draw. Verifies its memory offsets at runtime and switches itself off for the session on any mismatch.

vis-throttle-ms.name: [Experimental] Visibility throttle (ms)
vis-throttle-ms.description: 0 = off. Runs updateVisibility at most once per interval. A physics step is 4.17 ms (240 Hz): 5 = every 2nd step, 10 = every 3rd. Physics results are not proven identical in every level; use the debug checksum to compare.

vis-camera-delta.name: Throttle camera limit (units)
vis-camera-delta.description: While the throttle is active, updateVisibility still runs immediately if the camera moves this far or zoom/rotation changes.

debug-log.name: Debug log
debug-log.description: Every 2 seconds logs FPS, frame time avg/max, fast-batch skip ratio and throttle counters. Also logs a physics checksum for throttle testing. Leave off for normal play.
